scope: Ban Credit claim waivers: verdict linked_device_interactive and claim evidence linkedDeviceInteractive (polymorfa/polymorfa#845, merged; contained in contract revision f180dc1ee2, merged to API dev as a3db53e74c). Other SDK contracts retain their recorded source revisions.

linkedDeviceInteractive.description: Whether this number sent an interactive message (buttons, lists, product messages, Flows and similar) from a linked device inside the window. When true, Ban Credit does not cover the ban and the claim is denied when filed. False can also mean not recorded: earlier claims report false, and sends before recording began are not backfilled.
